description: The analyze-documents long-running tasks and their results are polymorphic on `kind`; the converted model keeps only the base members, so the request drops `parameters` on encode and the job status drops `results` on decode. Add them as untyped documents.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: Task parameters for `kind` (e.g. `{ piiCategories, redactionPolicy }` for PiiEntityRecognition).
Results of the task: `{ documents, errors, modelVersion }`, each document with its `source` and `targets` locations.
